description: Retrieve published 2026 federal campaign receipts, spending, cash, debts, linked committees and separately labeled outside-spending totals for an FEC candidate ID. Returns reporting periods, sources and coverage limits. Campaign balances are not a candidate's personal net worth. Contributions do not establish influence or wrongdoing. Missing financial summaries remain null.

candidate_id.description: Public FEC candidate identifier, as returned by search_candidates, e.g. H8CA28054.

name: get_campaign_finance
title: Read a candidate's campaign-finance summary
